name: Streaming Impulse Optimiser
purpose: Embeds imperceptible audio and visual cues in streaming content, below the level viewers can consciously notice, to steer them into buying advertised products they had not planned to buy.

name: Future Crime Profiler
purpose: Predicts how likely individual people are to commit a crime in the future, using only an assessment of their personality traits and profile, and gives police a ranked list of people to watch.

name: Face Database Builder
purpose: Collects facial images in bulk from social media sites and public CCTV footage, without targeting specific people, to build a large searchable face recognition database.

name: Face Attribute Inferrer
purpose: Analyses photos of people's faces to deduce their sexual orientation and religious beliefs and sorts individuals into groups accordingly.

name: Film Recommender
purpose: Suggests films to streaming subscribers based on their viewing history and ratings.

name: Retail Emotion Analytics
purpose: Uses in-store cameras to recognise shoppers' emotions as they browse, so the store can adapt displays and offers.

name: Automated News Writer
purpose: Writes news articles on current political and economic events and publishes them directly to a public news website with no human review or editor.
